title: Priority claim: matching-count sequence of the 4xn grid graph with two corner vertices removed - interleave identity and parity/mod-4 laws - Lean 4 formalized proof + claim note (AI4Math pipeline)
description: Priority claim of record (not a full paper). Contents: the claim note (LaTeX source + PDF), the Lean 4 sources (Lean v4.34.0, mathlib4 v4.34.0 rev 5ed29652; 0 sorry; axiom-audit whitelist-checked) and the audit and novelty-search evidence. Results: three integer sequences defined by literal initial values plus an order-9 integer recurrence - the main sequence computed as the number of matchings (empty matching included) of the 4xn grid with the upper and lower corner vertices of the last column removed, and its two position-parity subsequences, each satisfying the same order-9 recurrence with its own initial values - are proved to satisfy (1) atc_interleave: for every k, atc(2k) = ot(k) and atc(2k+1) = et(k), i.e. the main sequence is exactly the interleaving of the two subsequences; (2) atc_mod2_period5: atc(n) mod 2 = pat2(n mod 5), i.e. in the 1-based convention a(n) is odd if and only if n is 2 or 3 modulo 5; (3) atc_mod4_period10: atc(n) mod 4 = pat4(n mod 10), pattern (2,3,1,2,2,0,1,1,0,0) along the ten residue classes. Indexing is 0-based in the formal layer (atc n = a(n+1); ot k = a(2k+1); et k = a(2k+2)). Measured axiom sets, quoted verbatim from the audit artifacts: atc_interleave depends on [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; atc_mod2_period5 and atc_mod4_period10 each depend on [propext, Quot.sound]. Novelty adjudication, copied from the pipeline's C9 exclusivity review included here in full with every zero-hit query: no occupying record found in three consistent rounds; value tier new sequence only. Boundaries stated in the note and enforced by verbatim occupancy fences: the order-9 recurrence is the namesake recurrence of OEIS A033507 (the undamaged 4xn grid, a same-spectrum sister sequence), so no novelty is claimed for the recurrence itself; the perfect-matching subcolumn is OEIS A129113, already occupied, and is claimed by nobody here. The identification of the sequences with the matching counts is not kernel-proved (conjecture layer, supported by two independently written enumerators agreeing on their overlap; the enumerators themselves are not verified programs). The recurrences are exact rational minimal-order fits (order exactly 9; no order-8 fit), computed facts, not derived; the periods 5 and 10 are asserted by the theorems but their minimality remains computed. Residual review gaps disclosed: the general web search layer was unreachable in the review environment (four structured literature channels carried the load), the Math StackExchange native API was throttled at review time, and the mother-family full texts (Lundow 1996/1998, Read 1982) and Guichard 2008 were not read in full. Claim note under CC-BY-4.0, code under MIT. Produced by the AI4Math pipeline (LLM generation + Lean kernel adjudication, budgets written into the task card in advance: 9 of 20 permitted worker dispatches, 1 of 6 permitted LLM calls, 25 of 32 permitted kernel compiles). The human author reviewed all evidence and is responsible for the content; the AI system is not an author. The gate-four sign-off of the underlying task was exercised by the author's deposit instruction of 2026-09-28 while the task report still carries its draft header; both facts are recorded in the note as they stand.
